meta.title: The Siege of Blackstone Keep
meta.subtitle: An enemy army surrounds the castle. You must decide how to survive the siege.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: 🏰 The Siege Begins
scenes.narrative:
You stand atop the walls of Blackstone Keep.

An enemy army stretches across the horizon. Banners wave. War drums echo.

They have surrounded the castle.

A massive trebuchet is being assembled in the distance.

The siege has begun.

choices.text: Join the archers on the wall

scenes.title: 🏹 The Walls
scenes.narrative:
You take position with the archers.

Enemy soldiers begin advancing with shields raised.

The trebuchet launches its first stone.

scenes.title: ⚔️ Castle Courtyard
scenes.narrative:
Soldiers rush to prepare defenses.

Blacksmiths work quickly, and supplies are being distributed.

You can help prepare—or do something riskier.

choices.text: Grab armor and join the fight
Search for a secret way out

scenes.title: 👑 The War Room
scenes.narrative:
The commander studies a map.

'We cannot hold forever,' they say. 'We must either break the siege… or outlast it.'

choices.text: Suggest a night raid on the trebuchet

scenes.title: 💥 Walls Crumbling
scenes.narrative:
The trebuchet strikes the wall.

Stone explodes outward. A section weakens.

Another hit like that and the enemy will breach.

scenes.title: ⚔️ Clash at the Walls
scenes.narrative:
The enemy reaches the walls with ladders.

Steel clashes. The air fills with shouting.

You are in the middle of the fight.

scenes.title: 🚪 The Gate
scenes.narrative:
You reinforce the gates with beams and iron.

A battering ram slams into it.

Again.

And again.

scenes.title: 🗝️ Secret Tunnel
scenes.narrative:
You find an old passage beneath the castle.

It leads outside the walls… near the enemy camp.

choices.text: Use it to sabotage the trebuchet

scenes.title: 🌙 The Night Raid
scenes.narrative:
Under darkness, you sneak toward the trebuchet.

Guards patrol nearby.

One wrong move and you’re caught.

scenes.title: 🔥 Sabotage
scenes.narrative:
You successfully destroy the trebuchet.

The massive machine collapses into flames.

The enemy loses its greatest weapon.

scenes.title: Endurance
scenes.narrative:
Days pass. Food runs low.

Morale weakens.

But the enemy grows tired too.

scenes.title: Repair Effort
scenes.narrative:
You work quickly to reinforce the damaged wall.

Another strike hits—but holds.

You may have bought time.

scenes.title: Turning the Tide
scenes.narrative:
With the trebuchet gone and defenses holding, the enemy begins to falter.

Their lines weaken.

scenes.title: Unbreakable
scenes.narrative:
The gate holds.

The ram breaks apart.

The enemy retreats from the entrance.

scenes.title: Wounded
scenes.narrative:
You are struck in the fight.

You fall back, injured but alive.

scenes.title: Breakout
scenes.narrative:
You attempt to break through enemy lines.

It’s chaos outside the walls.

scenes.title: Caught
scenes.narrative:
You attack too soon.

Guards overwhelm you in seconds.

The raid fails.

scenes.title: The Breach
scenes.narrative:
The walls collapse.

The enemy floods into the castle.

Blackstone Keep falls.

scenes.title: Escape
scenes.narrative:
You escape the siege.

The castle’s fate remains unknown.

You live—but at a cost.

scenes.title: Survivor
scenes.narrative:
The siege ends after weeks.

The enemy withdraws.

You endured.

The castle still stands.

scenes.title: Victory
scenes.narrative:
The enemy breaks.

You drive them away from Blackstone Keep.

The siege is over.

You are victorious.
